--AZURE SYNAPSE 只支持NNVARCHAR，方便后期迁移DATABRICK用STRING
 --全部统一转NVARCHAR(25)
    --MOCK:
create EXTERNAL table tds_base_category1
(
    id           NVARCHAR(25),
    name         NVARCHAR(10) ,
    create_time  NVARCHAR(25)   ,
    operate_time NVARCHAR(25)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_base_category1/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_base_category2
(
    id           NVARCHAR(25),
    name         NVARCHAR(10) ,
    category1_id NVARCHAR(25),
    create_time  NVARCHAR(25)   ,
    operate_time NVARCHAR(25)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_base_category2/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_base_category3
(
    id           NVARCHAR(25),
    name         NVARCHAR(10) ,
    category2_id NVARCHAR(25),
    create_time  NVARCHAR(25)   ,
    operate_time NVARCHAR(25)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_base_category3/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);


create EXTERNAL table tds_base_province
(
    id           NVARCHAR(25)      ,
    name         NVARCHAR(20) ,
    region_id    NVARCHAR(20) ,
    area_code    NVARCHAR(20) ,
    iso_code     NVARCHAR(20) ,
    iso_3166_2   NVARCHAR(20) ,
    create_time  NVARCHAR(25)    ,
    operate_time NVARCHAR(25)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_base_province/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_base_region
(
    id           NVARCHAR(20) ,
    region_name  NVARCHAR(20) ,
    create_time  NVARCHAR(25)    ,
    operate_time NVARCHAR(25)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_base_region/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_base_trademark
(
    id           NVARCHAR(25) ,
    tm_name      NVARCHAR(100) ,
    logo_url     NVARCHAR(200) ,
    create_time  NVARCHAR(25)     ,
    operate_time NVARCHAR(25)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_base_trademark/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_order_detail
(
    id                    NVARCHAR(25) ,
    order_id              NVARCHAR(25)        ,
    sku_id                NVARCHAR(25)         ,
    sku_name              NVARCHAR(200)   ,
    img_url               NVARCHAR(200)   ,
    order_price           NVARCHAR(25),
    sku_num               NVARCHAR(25)         ,
    create_time           NVARCHAR(25)       ,
    split_total_amount    NVARCHAR(25) ,
    split_activity_amount NVARCHAR(25) ,
    split_coupon_amount   NVARCHAR(25) ,
    operate_time          NVARCHAR(25)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_order_detail/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_payment_info
(
    id               NVARCHAR(25),
    out_trade_no     NVARCHAR(50),
    order_id         NVARCHAR(25),
    user_id          NVARCHAR(25),
    payment_type     NVARCHAR(20),
    trade_no         NVARCHAR(50),
    total_amount     NVARCHAR(25),
    subject          NVARCHAR(200),
    payment_status   NVARCHAR(20),
    create_time      NVARCHAR(25),
    callback_time    NVARCHAR(25),
    callback_content NVARCHAR(1000),
    operate_time     NVARCHAR(25)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_payment_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_sku_info
(
    id              NVARCHAR(25) ,
    spu_id          NVARCHAR(25)            ,
    price           NVARCHAR(25)           ,
    sku_name        NVARCHAR(200)     ,
    sku_desc        NVARCHAR(2000)     ,
    weight          NVARCHAR(25)    ,
    tm_id           NVARCHAR(25)           ,
    category3_id    NVARCHAR(25)           ,
    sku_default_img NVARCHAR(300)      ,
    is_sale         NVARCHAR(25) ,
    create_time     NVARCHAR(25)          ,
    operate_time    NVARCHAR(25)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_sku_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_spu_info
(
    id           NVARCHAR(25) ,
    spu_name     NVARCHAR(200) ,
    description  NVARCHAR(1000) ,
    category3_id NVARCHAR(25)       ,
    tm_id        NVARCHAR(25)       ,
    create_time  NVARCHAR(25)     ,
    operate_time NVARCHAR(25)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_spu_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_user_info
(
    id           NVARCHAR(25) ,
    login_name   NVARCHAR(200) ,
    nick_name    NVARCHAR(200) ,
    passwd       NVARCHAR(200) ,
    name         NVARCHAR(200) ,
    phone_num    NVARCHAR(200) ,
    email        NVARCHAR(200) ,
    head_img     NVARCHAR(200) ,
    user_level   NVARCHAR(200) ,
    birthday     NVARCHAR(25)         ,
    gender       NVARCHAR(1)  ,
    create_time  NVARCHAR(25)     ,
    operate_time NVARCHAR(25)     ,
    status       NVARCHAR(200)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_user_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE tds_order_info (
    id                     NVARCHAR(25),
    consignee              NVARCHAR(100),
    consignee_tel          NVARCHAR(20),
    total_amount           NVARCHAR(25),
    order_status           NVARCHAR(20),
    user_id                NVARCHAR(25),
    payment_way            NVARCHAR(20),
    delivery_address       NVARCHAR(1000),
    order_comment          NVARCHAR(200),
    out_trade_no           NVARCHAR(50),
    trade_body             NVARCHAR(200),
    create_time            NVARCHAR(25),
    operate_time           NVARCHAR(25),
    expire_time            NVARCHAR(25),
    process_status         NVARCHAR(20),
    tracking_no            NVARCHAR(100),
    parent_order_id        NVARCHAR(25),
    img_url                NVARCHAR(200),
    province_id            NVARCHAR(25),
    activity_reduce_amount NVARCHAR(25),
    coupon_reduce_amount   NVARCHAR(25),
    original_total_amount  NVARCHAR(25),
    feight_fee             NVARCHAR(25),
    feight_fee_reduce      NVARCHAR(25),
    refundable_time        NVARCHAR(25)--,
    --CONSTRANVARCHAR(25) PK_ods_order_info PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (id) NOT ENFORCED  -- 定义主键
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_order_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);
